title: Kien nhan va khon ngoan

narration_voice.name: Ninh Đôn - Deep & Warm
narration_voice.reason: nam trung niên, trầm ấm, đọc chậm: hợp đạo lý

style: 2D minimalist flat animation, simple clean shapes, cinematic lighting with strong contrast between warm gold light and cool dark shadows, smooth natural character motion, gentle camera moves

subjects.hero: a simple white stick-figure man with a round head, thin black outline, wearing a small yellow miner helmet with a headlamp

settings.mine: inside a narrow underground gold mine tunnel, rough brown rock walls, wooden support beams, dust in the air, warm headlamp light
settings.fork: a road splitting into two paths at dusk: LEFT path is a dark narrow alley with a bright warm light glowing at its far end; RIGHT path is wide but covered in thick grey fog

lock: Keep the exact same stick-figure man with the yellow miner helmet in every clip. No narration, no voices, no speech; soft ambient sound only (pickaxe hits, wind, distant city hum).
negative: No text, no letters, no subtitles, no numbers on screen, no watermark, no realistic humans, no extra characters.

scenes.narration: Làm người, chịu khó thôi là chưa đủ. Bạn còn phải biết kiên nhẫn, và khôn ngoan.
scenes.subtitle: KIÊN NHẪN & KHÔN NGOAN
beats: the hero swings his pickaxe hard into the rock wall, sparks and dust fly
he keeps digging deeper with steady rhythm, sweat dripping, rocks falling around his feet
he pauses, breathing heavily, wipes his forehead and looks at the endless rock ahead

scenes.narration: Có những lúc, đích đến đã ở ngay trước mắt. Chỉ cần thêm một nhát cuốc nữa thôi, là chạm tới vàng.
scenes.subtitle: KIÊN NHẪN & KHÔN NGOAN
beats: camera slowly moves into a cross-section view of the rock wall in front of the hero
a thick glowing gold vein is revealed only a hand's width behind the thin rock where the hero's pickaxe tip rests; the hero, exhausted, cannot see it
scenes.camera: slow lateral dolly into cross-section view

scenes.narration: Nhưng ta lại mệt mỏi, giận dữ, vứt cuốc và quay lưng bỏ đi.
scenes.subtitle: KIÊN NHẪN & KHÔN NGOAN
beats: the hero angrily throws his pickaxe on the ground and kicks a rock
he turns his back and stomps away toward the tunnel exit
camera holds on the abandoned pickaxe lying right next to the hidden glowing gold vein, the hero's silhouette fading away in the background
scenes.camera: static medium shot, then slow pull-back

scenes.narration: Cũng có lúc, cuộc đời đặt ta trước một ngã rẽ, với hai con đường rất khác nhau.
scenes.subtitle: KIÊN NHẪN & KHÔN NGOAN
beats: the hero walks up to the fork in the road and stops
he looks left at the dark alley with the bright warm light at its end, then right at the wide path lost in thick grey fog, scratching his head
scenes.camera: wide shot from behind the hero, both paths visible

scenes.narration: Một lối le lói ánh sáng, nhưng cuối đường là ngõ cụt. Một lối mù mịt sương, nhưng phía sau là cả một vùng trời phồn hoa.
scenes.subtitle: KIÊN NHẪN & KHÔN NGOAN
beats: camera flies down the LEFT dark alley toward the bright light and reveals the light comes from a single lamp hanging on a solid brick wall: a dead end
camera swings to the RIGHT path, glides through the thick fog, and the fog parts to reveal a vast glowing prosperous city full of lights and life behind it
scenes.camera: fast flying camera move down the left path, then sweeping move through the fog of the right path

scenes.narration: Vậy mà ta lại cố bước vào con đường cụt tăm tối ấy.
scenes.subtitle: KIÊN NHẪN & KHÔN NGOAN
beats: back at the fork, the hero turns away from the foggy path and walks quickly into the dark alley toward the light
he reaches the brick wall, the lamp flickers
the lamp goes out, leaving him alone in darkness facing the wall
scenes.camera: tracking shot following the hero from behind, ending on a close shot of the wall

scenes.narration: Chịu khó là chưa đủ. Hãy đủ kiên nhẫn để đi đến cùng, và đủ khôn ngoan để chọn đúng đường.
scenes.subtitle: KIÊN NHẪN & KHÔN NGOAN
beats: in the dark, the hero slowly turns around and walks back out of the alley
he steps into the foggy path, the fog clears around him and the glowing city appears ahead at sunrise
scenes.camera: slow pull-back, ending in a wide hopeful shot

graphic.cue: kiên nhẫn để đi đến cùng
